crossRefs.note: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.
For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,
If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and…
having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois, and your mother…
having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains…
I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men…
The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

translations.web: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:
translations.bsb: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:
translations.kjv: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
translations.asv: for the truth's sake which abideth in us, and it shall be with us for ever:
